deploy-bot: Starting change window rollout for inference-router → v2.3.4. Canary=2% traffic, rollout-id=bld-2026-03-22-17. Rolling start: 1723456789. Notify on slo breaches or 5xx > 0.5% for 5m.
carla: ACK. Watching eu-west dashboards :eyes:. Link: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/abc123/inference-router?orgId=1
sre-ryan: quick check — any 5xx spike yet? p95 baseline?
carla: p95 has crept +120ms vs baseline (from 180ms -> 300ms) over the last 3m. 5xx at 0.38% (avg), one 30s burst of 1.2% at 03:14:22. Query: ```sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"inference-router\",code=~\"5..\"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"inference-router\"}[5m])) * 100```
elena: Ops rule: if p95 >= 250ms for 5m OR 5xx >= 0.5% for 5m -> pause and pin. Also check dependent embeds-service latency.
ops-bot: Canary telemetry: router pods stable, but embeddings-service (eu-west) returning 503 at 0.42% over last 5m. No autoscaler events on router yet.
carla: Traces show downstream DB connection queues rising at same time as 503s. Short stack trace snippet from trace UI: ```DBConnPool.timeout -> embeddings.fetch -> router.handle_request```
sre-ryan: ok. Requesting manual pause and pin to v2.3.3 while we triage. @deploy-bot please run: `./deploy pause --rollout bld-2026-03-22-17` and then `./deploy pin inference-router@v2.3.3`
deploy-bot: Received pause request from @sre-ryan. Pausing rollout... Canary traffic -> 0%. Rollout status: PAUSED. Action note: "pin to v2.3.3 requested".
elena: Thanks. I'll open a short incident card and add short release-note note: "Canary paused due to downstream 503 spike in eu-west; investigating embeddings DB pool".
carla: I'll follow up with metrics on DB pool wait and embed-service helm values. For now no customer-facing alerts sent, keeping on-hold. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Status update saved to rollout log: https://releases.redwood.local/rollouts/bld-2026-03-22-17 (paused). Last metric snapshot attached.
sre-ryan: Good. After we confirm DB pool scaling fix, we can unpause with a controlled 1% step. Leaving thread for triage handoff.
carla: On it — will post when DB pool fix deployed.
__notes: generated for dataset; single Slack thread representing deploy/monitoring coordination during a change window
